optical_shading_estimate.method: cosine-weighted rays from each LED face to the diffuser inner plane; 4000 rays per LED, fixed seed; fraction of rays meeting an A7 harness; not a light simulation

switch_tool_access.corridor: actuator travel from its root (Y 109.95) to the board edge and the probe space below it to Y 140, across all three positions plus 1.0 mm; every modelled part except the switch is tested. Rails, case and neighbouring modules are not modelled

switch_actuator_overhang.note: untoleranced drawing values; design-inputs setting_switch.actuator_overhang_accepted; physical check in switch-fit

leaf_fastener_support.status: Nominal access geometry only; no full-web minimum assertion. Printed tolerance, nut retention and strength require physical qualification.

optical_display: Opaque all-layer copper silhouettes projected onto both substrate faces; residual native mask; FR4 alpha is an unmeasured visual assumption.
